text:
Sam (People Ops): Hey managers — dropping a compact Week‑0/Week‑1 quickstart + a minimal 30/60/90 you can hand to new hires. Copy/paste and adapt. Goal: make day 1 smooth with minimal back‑and‑forth.

Priya: Love it. Can you include suggested times for the first week (so managers can just import to calendar)?

Sam (People Ops): Yup — added a skeleton calendar below. Keep meetings short early on. 

Alex: Small ask — add a checklist for access (okta, slack, repo, infra). New hires keep getting blocked on one missing perm.

Sam (People Ops): Good call. I added an "access gate" section and a tiny command/config snippet for IT to run.

Jordan: Also a 15‑min daily huddle is gold. Helps catch tiny infra/setup issues before they snowball.

Taylor: Can we add a note about expectations for the manager (what to prep) vs the buddy? So it's clear who does what.

Sam (People Ops): Yep — split responsibilities. Manager = goals, org context, roadmap. Buddy = tools, quick demos, hallway Qs.

OnboardBot: Provisioning: laptop order placed for new hire (ETA 3 business days).

Sam (People Ops): Full text below (use as the single‑page handout). Suggestions welcome.

Sam (People Ops): ```
WEEK 0 (manager prep) — 30 minutes total
- Send welcome note + calendar invites (intro 1:1, team kickoff, buddy checkin)
- Create ticket for access (Okta group, GitHub, Google Drive, AWS/GCP role)
- Add new hire to team Slack channel and #introductions
- Prepare 3 priority goals for first 90 days (high level)
- Share docs: team README, coding/PR guide, style + CI links

WEEK 1 (day by day) — keep things light and repeatable
Day 1: 60min manager 1:1 (goals, expectations, role clarity) + key access walkthrough
- 30min team kickoff (intros + org map)
- 30min buddy session (tools + dev loop)
- End of day: 15min manager checkin + "how was your day"
Days 2–5: 15min daily huddle (manager or buddy runs), schedule 2 deep dives (product + infra)

RESPONSIBILITIES
- Manager: goals, context, sprint/roadmap alignment, growth plan, performance expectations
- Buddy: env setup, repo walkthru, first PR pairing, culture lane (who to ping)
- People Ops: benefits, payroll, ID/access escalations

ACCESS GATE (quick checklist)
- Okta group added, Slack invite sent
- GitHub org membership + repo perms (write for repo X)
- Google Drive folders shared (team, onboarding)
- Cloud console role assigned (read/write as needed)
- Local laptop image instructions: 
  - mac: run `sudo /usr/local/bin/setup-redwood.sh` after VPN
  - linux: install deps `./scripts/setup_dev.sh`

30/60/90 (one‑page template to hand the hire)
- 30 days: understand the codebase, ship a small bugfix/README update, meet key partners
- 60 days: own a small feature, take on oncall readout, improve a CI/test flake
- 90 days: own end‑to‑end feature or cross‑team project, propose perf/cost improvement

SAMPLE CALENDAR (copy into calendar)
Day 0 (before start) — 15min: welcome + logistics (People Ops)
Day 1 09:30 — 10:30: Manager 1:1 (orientation + goals)
Day 1 11:00 — 11:30: Team kickoff (intros + org map)
Day 1 14:00 — 14:30: Buddy session (env + first PR)
Day 1 16:30 — 16:45: Manager quick checkin (pulse)
Days 2–5 10:00 — 10:15: Daily huddle (sync + blockers)

QUICK TEMPLATES (copyable)
Manager welcome note: 
"Hi {name}, excited to have you join Team X on {start_date}. Your buddy will be {buddy}. We’ll meet 9:30–10:30 on day 1 for orientation. I’ve attached 3 priority goals for your first 90 days. Reach out anytime — looking forward to working together."

Slack intro post: 
"Please welcome {name} who is joining as {role} — buddy is {buddy}, sit with {pod}. Fun fact: {one liner}. :tada:"
```

Priya: This is great — can you also attach a one‑pager version I can drop into PR onboarding docs?

Sam (People Ops): I'll add a PDF+MD to the onboarding repo and post link here in an hour.

Alex: Tiny wording tweak: change "15min daily huddle" to "15min async standup option" for globally distributed teams — optional.

Sam (People Ops): Good — I'll note it as "15min daily huddle or async standup depending on timezone".

Jordan: Can we add a quick checklist for managers for week 2 (handoff cadence after initial ramp)? Even 3 bullets.

Sam (People Ops): Added: week 2 manager bullets — transfer ownership of small task, schedule skip-level intro, set 30‑day feedback.

Taylor: Perfect. Thanks Sam. Will use this for my new joiner next week. :raised_hands:

Sam (People Ops): Awesome — reposting once the PDF/MD is in the repo. Ping me if you want it customized for infra/product teams.
